cd /workspace/tmp/dev && cat > bench3.py << 'PYEOF'
import json, time, importlib.util, sys
from collections import deque, defaultdict
from itertools import chain
from operator import itemgetter
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("m", "/workspace/submission/main.py")
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(m)

def setup(fn):
    obj = json.load(open(fn))
    services = obj["services"]; rules = obj["rules"]
    si = {s: i for i, s in enumerate(services)}
    atoms = m.collect_atoms(rules)
    mons = [m.build_monitor(op, p, si, len(services))[0] for op, p in atoms]
    states, trans = m.build_product(mons, len(services))
    finals = [len(p) for (op, p) in atoms]
    if rules[0]["when"]["op"] == "not":
        accept = [not all(st[i] == finals[i] for i in range(len(atoms))) for st in states]
    else:
        accept = [all(st[i] == finals[i] for i in range(len(atoms))) for st in states]
    return len(states), len(services), trans, accept

def run(n, k, trans, accept, inplace=True):
    t_all = time.time()
    rev = []; active = []
    for a in range(k):
        column = list(map(itemgetter(a), trans))
        buckets = defaultdict(list)
        for source, target in enumerate(column):
            buckets[target].append(source)
        rev.append(buckets)
        active.append({t for t, v in buckets.items() if v})
    distance = [None]*n
    pending = deque()
    for s in range(n):
        if accept[s]:
            distance[s] = 0; pending.append(s)
    while pending:
        u = pending.popleft(); far = distance[u]+1
        for sources in rev:
            for v in sources[u]:
                if distance[v] is None:
                    distance[v] = far; pending.append(v)
    groups = {}
    for s in range(n):
        groups.setdefault(distance[s], set()).add(s)
    blocks = list(groups.values())
    class_of = [0]*n
    for pos, blk in enumerate(blocks):
        for s in blk: class_of[s] = pos
    class_key = class_of.__getitem__
    queue = deque(range(len(blocks))); queued = set(queue)
    snapcost = 0
    while queue:
        bid = queue.popleft(); queued.discard(bid)
        blk = blocks[bid]
        if not blk: continue
        splitter = blk.copy()
        snapcost += len(splitter)
        for a in range(k):
            if splitter.isdisjoint(active[a]): continue
            sources = rev[a]
            movers = set(chain.from_iterable(map(sources.__getitem__, splitter)))
            if not movers: continue
            for cls in set(map(class_key, movers)):
                block = blocks[cls]
                moved = block & movers
                if not moved or len(moved) == len(block): continue
                if inplace:
                    block -= moved
                else:
                    stay = block - moved
                    blocks[cls] = stay
                fresh = len(blocks); blocks.append(moved)
                for s in moved: class_of[s] = fresh
                if cls in queued:
                    queued.add(fresh); queue.append(fresh)
                elif len(moved) <= len(blocks[cls]):
                    queued.add(fresh); queue.append(fresh)
                else:
                    queued.add(cls); queue.append(cls)
    return time.time() - t_all, len(set(class_of)), snapcost

for fn in sys.argv[1:]:
    n, k, trans, accept = setup(fn)
    print("== %s n=%d k=%d" % (fn, n, k))
    for mode in (False, True):
        t, cls, sc = run(n, k, trans, accept, mode)
        print("   inplace=%-5s %.3fs classes=%d snapcost=%d" % (mode, t, cls, sc))
PYEOF
